grassland-the-plank-footbridge.caption: A plank bridge over a ditch. The ditch is not deep, but the bridge is proud.

grassland-the-bramble-gap.caption: A gap in the brambles, wide enough for one gnome and one opinion.

grassland-the-shepherd-s-wall.caption: A dry-stone wall running off into the grass, with a gate that is mostly decoration.

grassland-the-wind-combed-meadow.caption: Grass lying down in one direction, as if told to. A kite string trails over the path.

grassland-the-dandelion-drift.caption: A drift of dandelion fluff, ready to leave at the first sneeze.

grassland-the-sleepy-windmill.caption: A little windmill turning slowly, in no hurry at all.

mountain-the-wind-notch.caption: A notch in the ridge where the wind plays whatever it likes.

mountain-the-goat-ledge.caption: A ledge with a goat. The goat is entirely unbothered.

grassland-the-daisy-ring.caption: A circle of daisies so even that someone must have measured. Nobody will own up.

forest-the-acorn-scatter.caption: Acorns everywhere, as though a squirrel had a very bad day.
